dedupe_keys.name: arctic geospatial data for cold region transportation infrastructure analysis

description: Arctic geospatial data for cold-region transportation infrastructure analysis is a data set deposited in UC Santa Barbara by its authors Emmanuel Chukwuemeka, Timothy Pasch (Department of Communication, University of North Dakota). Remote sensing makes it possible to gather data rapidly, accurately, and non-destructively, allowing for access to remote areas in near real-time. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The repository holds 15 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. Formats: XML. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
